top.query: select r1_0.id,b1_0.id,b1_0.created_at,b1_0.show_seat_id,b1_0.status,b1_0.user_id,r1_0.confirmed_payment_id,r1_0.created_at,r1_0.expires_at,r1_0.show_seat_id,ss2_0.id,ss2_0.show_id,ms1_0.id,ms1_0.movie_id,ms1_0.screen_id,ms1_0.start_time,ss2_0.screen_id,ss2_0.seat_id,ss2_0.status,r1_0.status,r1_0.user_id from tbooker.reservations r1_0 join tbooker.users u1_0 on u1_0.id=r1_0.user_id left join tbooker.bookings b1_0 on b1_0.id=r1_0.booking_id join tbooker.show_seats ss2_0 on ss2_0.id=r1_0.show_seat_id join tbooker.movie_shows ms1_0 on ms1_0.id=ss2_0.show_id where r1_0.id=$1 and u1_0.id=$2

INSERT INTO tbooker.payments (user_id, reservation_id, method, amount_minor, currency,
	idempotency_key, gateway_request_id, status, confirmation_status, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $9, $5, $6, $10, $11, $7, $8)
ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_payments_owner_key DO NOTHING

UPDATE tbooker.outbox_events SET status=$3,published_at=clock_timestamp(),
    lease_token=$4,lease_until=$5,last_error=$6
WHERE event_id=$1 AND status=$7 AND lease_token=$2

UPDATE tbooker.reservations SET status = $6, booking_id = $1, confirmed_payment_id = $2
WHERE id = $3 AND user_id = $4 AND status = $7 AND expires_at > $5

UPDATE tbooker.payments SET status = $1, provider_reference = $2, provider_version = $3,
	confirmation_status = CASE WHEN $4 = $7 THEN $8 ELSE $9 END,
	updated_at = clock_timestamp()
WHERE id = $5 AND provider_version < $6 AND status <> $10
select r1_0.id,r1_0.booking_id,r1_0.confirmed_payment_id,r1_0.created_at,r1_0.expires_at,r1_0.show_seat_id,r1_0.status,r1_0.user_id from tbooker.reservations r1_0 where r1_0.id=$1
UPDATE tbooker.payments SET confirmation_status = $2, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = $1 AND status = $3

INSERT INTO tbooker.processed_events(consumer_name,event_id,booking_id,payload_hash)
VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

UPDATE tbooker.reservations SET status = $3
WHERE show_seat_id = $1 AND status = $4 AND expires_at <= $2
SELECT id FROM tbooker.show_seats WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
select r1_0.show_seat_id from tbooker.reservations r1_0 where r1_0.id=$1 and r1_0.user_id=$2
UPDATE tbooker.show_seats SET status = $2 WHERE id = $1 AND status = $3
